_comment: ADR-025 per-assembly self-consistent weighting. Maps each benchmark isotope to the bare critical assembly whose openmc fundamental-mode flux (data/xs/weights/<assembly>.spectrum.json) weights its fast4 collapse. Isotopes absent from this map keep the analytic fast-metal weight (tools/xs/weighting.py) and are byte-identical to the ADR-024 v3 set. openmc supplies the flux SHAPE only; no cross section is touched, and no weight is ever tuned toward a benchmark k.
